query: Which mediator measures will be prioritized for measurement-error correction, and will we use attenuation-correction formulas or Bayesian measurement-error models with specified priors?

response.query: Which mediator measures will be prioritized for measurement-error correction, and will we use attenuation-correction formulas or Bayesian measurement-error models with specified priors?
response.answer: Bayesian measurement-error models with specified priors will be prioritized for correction. Attenuation-correction formulas are not used. This approach provides more accurate estimates.
